logical_content: readable numeric values or intervals with units
missing statistics quality and causal evidence

accepted_native_equivalents: formulas only with trusted actual recalculation

image_regions.source: exact original PNG SHA and actual local evidence
forbidden_substitutes: constructor geometry presented as independent reading

numeric_rule: Readable anchor plus publicly specified tolerance; no hidden exact array value or artificially narrow model interval scoring.
verdict_rule: Actual fact/compound/proof-sufficiency target matters; label alone never certifies interpretation. No verdict-frequency whitelist.
artifact_style_rule: No fixed cell coordinates, Sheet names or reference color/page-count requirements; small structured region records allowed, giant JSON screenshots do not replace core native content.
private_scoring_boundary: Missing original image/independent annotation/GT/helper/decoder or unsupported legal representation is evaluator error/pending review, not candidate0.
